| [`monolithic-overflow-032-print.tentative.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/css/css-page/monolithic-overflow-032-print.tentative.html) | Fail | 0 / 1 | BUG | the monolithic content that does not fit in an empty page is sliced, and a box with `box-decoration-break: clone` does not repeat its edges at the slices, but Blink and Gecko (as the comment of the test says; Gecko passes, Blink fails) also end the fragment of the box right after the monolithic content (with its block-end edges) and start a new fragment of the box after it in the same page (with its block-start edges): the content after the monolithic content is placed after the end of the monolithic content without these edges (the third and next pages differ).
